Import the .mca file

Source: R/atoc_import.R
importMCA.Rd

Import the .mca file

Usage

importMCA(
  file,
  silent = TRUE,
  ncores = 1,
  full_import = FALSE,
  working_timetable = FALSE,
  public_only = TRUE
)

Arguments

file

Path to .mca file

silent

logical, should messages be displayed

ncores

number of cores to use when parallel processing

full_import

import all data, default FALSE

working_timetable

use rail industry scheduling times instead of public times

public_only

only return calls that are for public passenger pick up/set down

Value

named list of data tables: stop_times and schedule, plus (when full_import is TRUE) TI, TA, TD, AA, and CR records

Details

Imports the .mca file and returns data.frame
